entries.name: Kusogaki
entries.content:
Refers to female characters who consistently exhibit arrogant, domineering, dismissive, and teasing attitudes toward older individuals. Traditionally applied to significant age gaps (typically adult authority figures), though contemporary usage increasingly includes smaller age differences as the trope gains mainstream acceptance.

Considered a positive descriptor. Characteristic behaviors include:
- Frequently calling others "small fry" ("Small fry❤️~Small fry❤️~", "My small fry owner!")
- High offensive capability paired with low/zero defense (all bark, no bite)
- Easily "disciplined" by more mature individuals through various means:

  • Being lectured with life experience
  • Receiving physical "corrections"

entries.name: Domesticated Goblins,Goblin-kin,goblin
entries.content:
A subspecies evolved from goblins through prolonged interbreeding with humans until modern times. Their ancestral goblin ferocity has been eradicated, resulting in docile creatures capable of basic labor and verbal communication. Consequently, they have surpassed cats/dogs in popularity as companion pets.

Key characteristics:
- Lifespan: 30-40 years, lifecycle proportionally quickened
- Diet: Standard human diet
- Physiology: Green skin, yellow irises, black sclera, horizontal pupils
- Cognitive capacity: Basic self-management skills, trainable through speech
- Reproductive system: Fully functional human-style female genitalia enabling sexual utility

The petite, cute female specimens enjoy particularly high demand among human males. Modern domesticated goblins are widely considered ideal male companions. Their limited social cognition leads them to perceive cohabiting adult heterosexual humans as "mates."

Owners may observe significant physiological development in their domesticated goblins' breasts and genitalia through prolonged sexual interaction, gradually conforming to the owner's sexual preferences.

During copulation, female specimens instinctively perform actions to stimulate male arousal (posing, sexual reactivity, speech). This is widely attributed to their species' reproductive reliance on human male partners.

When "educating" female goblins, the most effective method involves rape accompanied by violent sexual acts. This triggers their biological instinct to recognize the owner as a "male capable of impregnation," thereby actively establishing a master-servant relationship.

Demonstrating the value of their bodies is crucial for goblins. Clothing received from owners represents affection and social status within their hierarchy - essential requirements for achieving happiness.
